rep.angle: lead with a peer company's result
rep.name: Leo

rep_lines.text: Marcus, Leo from HyperSale. A fintech peer cut AE ramp by two months; can I take 30 seconds to explain how?
They used AI buyer roleplays and quote-backed scoring to expose coaching gaps weekly, not at quota time. What makes ramp take seven months today?
When reps stumble on integration questions, what happens to those opportunities, and how much of the seven-month ramp do you attribute to that?
If integration gaps add two months, how many new AEs face this annually, and what does each delayed month cost in pipeline or revenue?
That’s potentially hundreds of thousands in delayed pipeline annually. How do you currently prepare reps for integration questions, and where does that process break down?
We turn your integration scenarios into adaptive buyer roleplays, then score every response with the exact quote behind it. Which scenarios derail reps most?
When API and migration questions arise, what must reps diagnose versus escalate, and how much engineering or manager time does that consume weekly?

criteria.rationale: You identified yourself, your company, and a relevant fintech ramp result immediately. To make this exemplary, deliver the concise relevance statement directly instead of asking permission for 30 seconds.
